title: Finite object and arrow lists agree at a common refinement
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and $O=\operatorname{colim}(F\circ\mathrm{Ob})$ its chosen object-set colimit. Equip $O$ with a category structure and functors $V_j:F(j)\to O$. Assume $V_j$ has the object colimit coprojection as object map and $F(f)\circ V_k=V_j$ for every $f:j\to k$. Assume an arrow-set colimit cocone $a$ and equivalence $e:a.\mathrm{pt}\simeq\mathrm{Arrow}(O)$ identify its coprojections with the arrow maps of $V_j$ [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Given stages $j,k$ and lists of $n$ objects and $m$ arrows at each stage whose respective $V_j,V_k$ images coincide term by term, there exist a stage $t$ and maps $f:j\to t$, $g:k\to t$ such that the transitioned object lists and arrow lists coincide term by term.

source.place: proof of Lemma Tag 09YL (lemma-colimit-sites), first paragraph: 'The formula C = colim C_i means that Ob(C) = colim Ob(C_i) and Arrows(C) = colim Arrows(C_i). Then source, target, and composition are inherited ... Remark that given any finite diagram in C there exists an i such that this diagram is the image of a diagram in C_i' (stated without proof); filtered colimits of sets: categories.tex Section Tag 04AX

proof.text: First place both lists at IsFiltered.max j k. Prove finite_stage_eq by induction on the list length, using Types.FilteredColimit.isColimit_eq_iff' for the last entry and mapping earlier equalities along each refinement. Apply it first to the object colimit, then to the arrow cocone after using e.injective and compatibility of V to transfer arrow-image equality. Map object equalities to the final stage; F.map_comp identifies the composites out of j and k. The empty induction case uses the identity map at the current stage.

lean.statement: theorem filteredColimit_category_list_equality (J : Type z) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{z, z}) : let O := colimit (F ⋙ Cat.objects) ∀ (_s : Category.{z} O) (V : ∀ j : J, F.obj j ⥤ O), ((∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j), (V j).obj X = colimit.ι (F ⋙ Cat.objects) j X) ∧ (∀ (j k : J) (f : j ⟶ k), (F.map f).toFunctor ⋙ V k = V j) ∧ (∃ (a : Cocone (F ⋙ Cat.arrows)) (e : a.pt ≃ Arrow O), Nonempty (IsColimit a) ∧ ∀ (j : J) (f : Arrow (F.obj j)), e (a.ι.app j f) = (V j).mapArrow.obj f)) → (∀ (n m : ℕ) (j k : J) (Xj : Fin n → F.obj j) (Xk : Fin n → F.obj k) (Aj : Fin m → Arrow (F.obj j)) (Ak : Fin m → Arrow (F.obj k)), (∀ q, (V j).obj (Xj q) = (V k).obj (Xk q)) → (∀ p, (V j).mapArrow.obj (Aj p) = (V k).mapArrow.obj (Ak p)) → ∃ (t : J) (f : j ⟶ t) (g : k ⟶ t), (∀ q, (F.map f).toFunctor.obj (Xj q) = (F.map g).toFunctor.obj (Xk q)) ∧ (∀ p, (F.map f).toFunctor.mapArrow.obj (Aj p) = (F.map g).toFunctor.mapArrow.obj (Ak p)))
